'''Alex Dei-Licoli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]] as an [[Imperial Agent|agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] he traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. He was assigned to the [[Science and Research]] branch of the Alliance under [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alex Dei-Licoli appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion as the [[Imperial Agent]] vendor inside [[Alliance base|Odessen base]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> He stands as an homage to a Lead Game Master who worked at a [[BioWare]] facility in Ireland before dying in [[2015]].<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|HK_Infinity|status/1089586910375436288|[[Hazel Kelly]]|quote=If you play #SWTOR, and pass by Odessen - be sure to wave to the NPC Alex Dei-Licoli in by the GTN. A perfect home for the guy who helped restore items for players. He left us for a galaxy far, far away 4 years ago today, but forever lives on in SWTOR &lt;3<br />He was a Lead GM based in Ireland, where the main GM team for SWTOR was/is located. There is more than Alex, but I'm not sure of all them. KoTFE is when Alex arrived in game and we dedicated the explanation to his memory, and 3 other amazing devs we lost that year.|archivedate=20210527123320}}</ref>
